profile: universal approximators: manageable collections of relatively simple nonlinear functions that serve as fundamental building blocks of an infinitude. They are part of a first step in organizing the pursuit of automation by grouping such building blocks into practical sets. Three popularly used strains are fixed-shape approximators, artificial neural networks, and trees.
